extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from XML methods/results, figure captions, and OA package figures; no figure-only exact values were fabricated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NPN uptake and SYTOX green assays provide direct membrane-permeabilization evidence in E. coli for reported peptide analogs, with B1CTcu5-LIAG described as producing strong inner membrane permeabilization.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source gives qualitative/relative figure interpretation rather than a source table of exact fluorescence values.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: B1CTcu5, DB1CTcu5, B1CTcu5W, B1CTcu5K, B1CTcu5LGG, and N-terminal deletion analogs
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Flow-cytometric DiBAC4(3) assay shows membrane depolarization capacity for several analogs and reduced depolarization after N- or C-terminal/rana-box deletions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure 4 supports directionality and analog grouping; exact per-analog event percentages are not tabulated locally.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: B1CTcu5K, DB1CTcu5, B1CTcu5W, B1CTcu5R, B1CTcu5H, B1CTcu5-LIAG, and parent B1CTcu5
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Crystal-violet biofilm assay supports antibiofilm phenotype against S. aureus biofilm after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm inhibition is a phenotype, not a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structure-activity reasoning supports an N-terminal active-core contribution and a C-terminal/rana-box contribution to activity, but this is inferred from analog MIC/hemolysis/SAR patterns rather than a single direct binding target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote SAR discussion alone to a direct mechanism or target-binding claim.
